h: The Treasury of Fear Opens the Three Gifts of Shabbos

p: לָדַעַת כִּי אֲנִי ה׳ מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם (שְׁמוֹת לא, יג)
"'That you may know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you' (Shemos 31:13):
אָמַר לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְמֹשֶׁה
HaKadosh Baruch Hu said to Moshe:
and I wish to give it to Yisrael," etc.
אֶלָּא אוֹצָר שֶׁל יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם בִּלְבָד
but a storehouse of fear of Heaven alone";
and about that it is impossible to say
that it is the good gift
"Everything is in the hands of Heaven
except the fear of Heaven," etc.
is the storehouse of fear of Heaven,
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ
And this is according to what they said in the Midrash
(Rabbah and Tanchuma, Parshas Matos; Bamidbar Rabbah 22:7, Tanchuma Matos 5):
ג׳ מַתָּנוֹת בָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בָּעוֹלָם
"HaKadosh Baruch Hu created three gifts in the world:
If a person merited one of them,
he takes the most desirable thing in the whole world," etc.;
When they are gifts of Heaven
and come from the power of the might
This is the reading in the Tanchuma;
and in the Midrash Rabbah the reading is
"and come through the power of the Torah."
And according to this reading we must understand:
which is one of the three gifts,
certainly refers to the wisdom of the Torah,
so what is the meaning of
"and come through the power of the Torah"?
But according to the reading of the Tanchuma,
that they come from the power of the might
it may be that the expression "power of the might"
refers to the attribute of Malchus,
is the main thing on the part of man;
and on this depend all three gifts
and they are all in His treasure house,
which is the storehouse of fear of Heaven.
and this is truly a good gift
for "were it not that HaKadosh Baruch Hu
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג פ, סוֹף עַמּוּד ב)
and it says in the holy Zohar (III 80b, end of the amud):
comes from the side of Gevurah";
(in the Introduction, the passage beginning "The fourth commandment"):
"and when it is taken from Gevurah,
it is called Torah she'b'al peh;
was given from the mouth of the Almighty;
and there the mighty stand in the breach,
and none can stand in it
except one mighty in the battle of Torah,
And this is Malchus, the Mouth
we call it Torah she'b'al peh.
of "comes from the power of the might
"And one who wishes to become rich should face north"
in the statement of the Gemara in Shabbos mentioned above:
"The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשָׁה יא)
(as they said, Bereishis Rabbah, beginning of parsha 11);
the Torah was given on Shabbos (Shabbos 86b);
which is the day of Shabbos.
that was hidden away for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh
and it says in Sefer HaBahir:
and placed it for them in its place,
and the rest He hid away for the tzaddikim."
הוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּמְּכִילְתָּא
this is according to what they said in the Mechilta:
"'Who keeps the Shabbos from desecrating it,
וְשׁוֹמֵר יָדוֹ מֵעֲשׂוֹת כָּל רָע (יְשַׁעְיָה נו, ב)
and keeps his hand from doing any evil' (Yeshayahu 56:2)"
and in Pri Etz Chaim the wording is
that one is saved from the accusation of the yetzer hara.
Therefore they called Shabbos "a good gift,"
for it includes the three gifts in the world,
and it is in the treasure house
which is the storehouse of fear of Heaven.
when they come from the power of the might
and they are the attributes of the Avos.
Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him
and Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
and his attribute is "the Fear of Yitzchak,"
And Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him:
it says in the holy Zohar (Vayakhel, 204a):
"The shin is the secret of the three Avos;
the bas is crowned with them."
the holiness of the three Avos,
and they merit the three gifts.
Yisrael are called "those who fear My Name"
when the fear of Hashem falls
"The awe of Shabbos is upon the am ha'aretz"
עַל יְדֵי זֶה זוֹכִין לְהַג׳ מַתָּנוֹת
through this they merit the three gifts
that come through the power of the might

p: when the fear of Hashem falls upon the Jew,
"Before Him we will serve with awe and fear,"
the meal of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him;
"And wine, which is to raise the voice
comes from the side of Imma;
and they stand in judgment," etc.
And this is what we say:
"the Levi'im at their song and their music";
וְיַיִן יְשַׂמַּח לְבַב אֱנוֹשׁ (תְּהִלִּים קד, טו)
and "wine gladdens the heart of man" (Tehillim 104:15).
that is with joy and goodness of heart?
meaning to improve the two hearts:
"the heart of the wise at his right" (Koheles 10:2)
and the heart of the fool
the yetzer tov and the yetzer hara;
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה מח, יא)
אֵין יֵצֶר הָרָע שׁוֹלֵט בַּמַּלְאָכִים וְכוּלֵּי
the yetzer hara has no dominion over angels," etc.
And when one improves the fool's heart as well,
emptying the evil out of it,
it could be a joy of revelry;
that he was very merry, etc.,
And when the yoke of the Kingship of Heaven is upon him,
there is no fear of levity,
who are from the side of Gevurah,
their occupation is song and music.
And so Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
whose attribute is "the Fear of Yitzchak"
in which all joy is found,
to gladden the side of the Levi'im."
And therefore at the first meal,
And this is what we say:
as it is written regarding Egypt (Shemos 2:23):
"And they groaned," etc., "and they cried out";
the groaning of the Children of Israel," etc.
is what oppresses and distresses Yisrael.
are called by the name of Egypt,
(מִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה שְׁמִינִי יג, וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה יג, ה)
the kelipos of all the nations,
for they all oppress and distress Yisrael;
And this is what it says (Tehillim 107:6):
"And they cried out to Hashem in their distress;
from their straits He delivers them."
when they are saved from the yetzer hara
there is naturally no crying out,
since they are saved from the yetzer hara,
for on Shabbos the blemish is rectified
"You change his face and send him away"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה יב, ו)
and on Shabbos "He blessed it with the light of his face"
on Shabbos each one of Yisrael is called
הוּבָא בְּתוֹסָפוֹת כְּתוּבּוֹת ז, סוֹף עַמּוּד ב)
cited in Tosafos, Kesubos 7b, end of the amud):
"'A psalm, a song for the Shabbos day':
New faces have come here," etc.
for blood is in the nefesh,
and "the essential blood is the liver"
and the liver is the level of Esav
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רלד, סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
and the ruach is in the heart,
and there too is the fool's heart
and "the neshamah that You placed in me
in the letters vav and hei:
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קכג, רֵישׁ עַמּוּד ב)
as is written (Zohar III 123b, top of the amud).
and they are present on Shabbos,
for Shabbos is the time of Torah;
and all day long he is occupied with a mitzvah,
and it is as if he did a mitzvah
And this is what it says:
after he has come to goodness of heart
with which he overcomes his inclination,
and "joy for the upright of heart" (Tehillim 97:11);
that they merit the two gifts
for all three they merit on Shabbos,
that is hidden in the storehouse of fear of Heaven,
